Prediction-if-false: the same statue/march-in-place basin persists even at the bank's own simplest already-validated case -- this is a genuine from-scratch PPO exploration/basin-barrier problem independent of command complexity, and the next lever is a structurally different mechanism (RSI from teacher_v2 motion-library poses matched to THIS stack, or a stance-load curriculum), not another task-distribution or reward-dose tweak.
